howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可访问 golden_chat 的 Slack 聊天记录(6 条消息、3 位用户、#engineering 和 #random 频道),能从中查找团队讨论过的解决方案、代码片段、决策、排障步骤和共享链接。
howto.when: 当你要测试 golden_chat 的 golden build,或需要检索该 Slack 聊天记录里的方案、代码等内容时触发。

把 #engineering 里的 Python 代码片段列出来

howto.what_en: Claude can access the golden_chat Slack chat history (6 messages, 3 users, #engineering and #random channels) and find solutions, code snippets, decisions, troubleshooting steps, and shared links discussed by the team.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are testing the golden_chat golden build, or when you need to look up solutions, code snippets, or other content from this Slack chat history.

say_en.text: Search golden_chat for discussions about troubleshooting

say_en.text: List the Python code snippets from #engineering
